reason: My aunts send me thobes and abayas from Amman and Dubai, and I stock up when I go back. I'm not short on anything for this season, so I'd probably walk in to look and maybe join the Ramadan list, but I wouldn't buy this month.
objection: Is this a real boutique that will still be here next Ramadan, or a pop-up that opens with a big sale and disappears? And I can get embroidered crepe thobes back home for a fraction of $75.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing embroidery and fabric quality that I honestly can't get from family abroad, or a piece I need for a specific wedding coming up that I can't get shipped in time.
